label: Vultr infrastructure connector
summary: Prepare bounded infrastructure inventory and reviewed provisioning for a selected Vultr account.
core_boundary: An external account token is not a Core entitlement or permission to rebuild, destroy or import a node. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Bind account, resource identifiers and location/capability choices to the current authorized plan.
Refuse unmanaged resource rebuild/delete operations and preserve ownership across credential changes.
Exercise delayed provider responses, duplicate requests and retained-data recovery after a failed rebuild.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
